description:
This request deletes the data from the specified existing custom field or private extension. If you want to clear the data extension value (to make the custom field or private extension blank), you must use `data_ext_del`. The DataExtMod request can’t be used to clear the field.

Returns the v2 request to send, and the webhook payload QuickBooks' answer arrives in (this operation's response_json: its data shape and the status codes to handle).

Possible errors (error.code / error.type; the call result explains each): 1030 unsupported_request, 3000 invalid_object_id, 3040 invalid_amount, 3070 string_too_long, 3120 object_not_found, 3140 invalid_reference, 3150 missing_element, 3160 cannot_delete, 3161 closing_date_delete, 3170 cannot_modify, 3175 in_use, 3176 locked, 3200 stale_edit_sequence, 3210 invalid_value, 3220 not_authorized, 3231 request_not_processed, 3250 feature_not_enabled, 3260 insufficient_permission, 3261 personal_data_access_denied, 3262 payroll_subscription_required, 3263 read_only_access, 3264 merchant_services_subscription_required

data_ext_del.description: DataExt The DataExtAdd request writes data to the specified data extension for the specified object.

data_ext_name.description: The name of the data extension. If this is a custom field, `data_ext_name` will be visible as a label in the QuickBooks user interface.

list_data_ext_type.description:
The type of list object (e.g. Customer) that this data extension is attached to.

Choose exactly one of: the set (`list_data_ext_type`, `list_obj_ref`), or the set (`txn_data_ext_type`, `txn_id`, `txn_line_id`), or `other_data_ext_type`. Members of a set combine with each other, not with the other choices.

list_obj_ref.description:
Refers to a list object. In a DataExtAdd request, the list object ref must be the same type as the type specified in `list_data_ext_type`.

Choose exactly one of: the set (`list_data_ext_type`, `list_obj_ref`), or the set (`txn_data_ext_type`, `txn_id`, `txn_line_id`), or `other_data_ext_type`. Members of a set combine with each other, not with the other choices.

full_name.description: The record's name, parents first: `Jones:Kitchen:Cabinets`. Not case-sensitive.

list_id.description: QuickBooks' ID for the record. Used over `full_name` when both are sent.

other_data_ext_type.description:
Not supported.

Choose exactly one of: the set (`list_data_ext_type`, `list_obj_ref`), or the set (`txn_data_ext_type`, `txn_id`, `txn_line_id`), or `other_data_ext_type`. Members of a set combine with each other, not with the other choices.

owner_id.description: `owner_id` identifies who owns the data extension. Use 0 for QuickBooks custom fields that appear in the UI, or use a GUID for private extensions owned by an app.

txn_data_ext_type.description:
The type of transaction that the data extension belongs to.

Choose exactly one of: the set (`list_data_ext_type`, `list_obj_ref`), or the set (`txn_data_ext_type`, `txn_id`, `txn_line_id`), or `other_data_ext_type`. Members of a set combine with each other, not with the other choices.

txn_id.description:
`txn_id` is the unique QuickBooks identifier for a transaction. Use it to reference that transaction in later requests.

Choose exactly one of: the set (`list_data_ext_type`, `list_obj_ref`), or the set (`txn_data_ext_type`, `txn_id`, `txn_line_id`), or `other_data_ext_type`. Members of a set combine with each other, not with the other choices.

txn_line_id.description:
Identification number of the transaction line. (`txn_line_id` is supported as of v2.0 of the SDK. With qbXML v1.0 and v1.1, `txn_line_id` is always returned as zero.)

Choose exactly one of: the set (`list_data_ext_type`, `list_obj_ref`), or the set (`txn_data_ext_type`, `txn_id`, `txn_line_id`), or `other_data_ext_type`. Members of a set combine with each other, not with the other choices.

include_qbxml.description: Also return the qbXML this compiles to, for debugging. Not part of the v2 request.

request_id.description: Your own label for the request, sent to QuickBooks as its qbXML `requestID` and echoed in the raw answer (`response_xml`); optional, since the answer's webhook already carries the request's `id`.

name: delete_data_ext

body.description: The JSON body: the arguments you passed.

headers.description: Send with the request. Resent unchanged when no 201 came back, it answers with the request already queued.

qbxml.description: The qbXML it compiles to. Only with include_qbxml.

webhook.description: JSON Schema of the payload POSTed to webhook_url once QuickBooks answers, with this operation's response_json (data shape and status codes).
